title: Bao nhiêu — Asking the price, counting one to three

segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Greet an older man politely.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, xin chào anh.] [EN: Address an older woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị.] [EN: Address a younger person.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Em.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Cảm ơn anh.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Thank you, to an older man.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: At a coffee stall, you ask the price. Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, xin chào anh.] [EN: To ask the price, say] [VI_M: Bao nhiêu?] [EN: This means how much. Both syllables have a flat tone.] [EN: Ask how much.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao nhiêu?] [EN: Politely, attach her pronoun.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao nhiêu chị?] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now numbers. One.] [VI_F: Một.] [EN: This means one. It has a falling, broken tone.] [EN: Say one.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Một.] [EN: Two.] [VI_F: Hai.] [EN: This means two. It has a flat tone.] [EN: Say two.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hai.] [EN: Three.] [VI_F: Ba.] [EN: This means three. It has a flat tone.] [EN: Say three.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ba.] [EN: Now count.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Một, hai, ba.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. How much?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao nhiêu?] [EN: One.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Một.] [EN: Three.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ba.] [EN: Two.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hai.] [EN: Ask an older woman how much.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao nhiêu chị?] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Hai.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Two.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Bao nhiêu?] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: How much.] [EN: And the polite yes.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen at the coffee stall.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Chị ơi, bao nhiêu?] [VI_F: Dạ, hai mươi ngàn.] [EN: She said twenty thousand; you will learn the price words soon.] [VI_M: Dạ, cảm ơn chị.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Ask an older woman how much.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao nhiêu chị?] [EN: Count one, two, three.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Một, hai, ba.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you count higher. The preview word is] [VI: bốn] [EN: which means four.]
